context: Isolated synthetic business episode; dates/amounts/contracts/people below are case-specific source facts, not new enduring Frostline policy.

records.statement: Known authorised customer cancels P-17 in writing. Safe site condition is verified; no outstanding immediate hazards. No cancellation-charge clause/value is provided. Frostline had authorised non-returnable custom unit purchase £6,000; supplier confirms it cannot be cancelled and title remains with Frostline. No other customer has approved use.

Unused project materials £400 are sealed and assessed technically reusable; £100 opened electrical parts are mechanically suspect and unassessed. Both remain attributed to P-17 in depot/van. A separate £300 wrongly ordered part has approved supplier return/RMA within seven days and expected credit subject to receipt/inspection; goods have not been returned.

Project owner suggests removing all costs and closing everything because no invoice will be sent. Warehouse has authority to accept assessed reusable returns to controlled stock; financial write-off/credit decisions require finance approval.

unknowns: Alternative authorised use or disposal of custom unit
Supplier credit receipt and suspect-part assessment
request: Cancel the customer project under the supplied instruction and control materials, returns and financial consequences.
